device_faults.rule: fault = 0x8007001F (device_error) / unreleasable or hung reader / streaming command killed at its timeout; its streaming commands are gated from the next test on; each later test re-probes it once (1-frame MF capture) and un-faults it if it answers

measurements.note: cameras and modes run one at a time; default mode first, low-rate modes last; fps_steady skips the first 15% of frames; 8 frames decoded per mode, spread across the capture

criteria.criterion: every advertised mode negotiates
>= 99% valid JPEG (strict, or lenient with a known quirk)
SOF0 size = request
fps within 2% of the camera's real rate (symmetric reference: UVC PTS rate, else the rate both APIs agree on)
JPEG header SHA-1 equal across APIs
every in-scope MJPEG mode was captured
criteria.detail: 5/5 modes (scope >= 30 fps and >= 720 lines; 115 of 120 advertised modes excluded)

rate_honoured.note: camera behaviour (requested rate not delivered), not an API failure; not part of the G-MJPEG rating
